overall_scope: Output-locked direct-attach branch of ActionPrototypeTypes::apply (coreaction.cc:4637-4649) driven through the production apply, three scenarios: locked-int attach (append-at-last-slot, halt/dead skip, typelock update), locked-void gate, unlocked initActiveOutput control; not a whole-ActionPrototypeTypes MATCH (model glue residual, multi-output-entry model, e2e fold chain out of lease)

architecture.type_factory: FixtureArchitecture: xunknownN core set + setupSizes + int4/void via getBase; fixture ProtoModel with one <output><pentry> register entry at offset 0 (minsize 1 maxsize 8 extension inttype), every <register name> resolving to register:0x0:8

compiler_spec.ghidra_prototype: FuncProto::setInternal + setPieces(PrototypePieces{model=fixture, outtype}) — updateAllTypes runs ProtoModel::assignParameterStorage (fspec.cc:2429, ParamListStandardOut::assignMap fspec.cc:1569-1581) and store->setOutput fills the output ProtoParameter; locks input+output+model (fspec.cc:3843-3852)
compiler_spec.rugra_prototype: flat FuncProto: return_type=int4|void + set_output_lock(true); storage derived at apply time from ProtoModel::default_x86_64().output_entries[0] (Register 0x0)
compiler_spec.scope: prototype interaction only: apply reads isOutputLocked, the output type metatype/size and the model output entry; no FuncCallSpecs involved

analysis_options.action: production ActionPrototypeTypes (apply) invoked directly once per scenario; onceperfunc
analysis_options.slot0: constant 0 on every RETURN so the cc:4628-4635 strip loop is a no-op and the locked branch is isolated
analysis_options.halt_dead_markers: PcodeOp::halt / PcodeOp::dead flags OR-ed directly (test-only private access, same rewrite as returnfold_gapb_1204.cc)

graph.scenario_A: gapa at ram:0x60000, 5 BlockBasic blocks: b0 entry fan-out (no ops); b1 [RETURN @0x60010 slot0 const]; b2 [RETURN @0x60018 slot0 const + slot1 V]; b3 [RETURN @0x60020 flags|=halt]; b4 [RETURN @0x60028 flags|=dead]; V = register:0x40:4 input varnode
graph.scenario_B: gapb at ram:0x61000, 1 block [RETURN @0x61010 slot0 const], locked void
graph.scenario_C: gapc at ram:0x62000, 1 block [RETURN @0x62010 slot0 const], unlocked

input_manifest.varnodes: V = register:0x40:4 marked setInput (away from the locked output storage register:0x0); attached outputs land at register:0x0:4 (size from the locked int type, not the 8-byte register)

observation_schema.records: schema=1, preA, retA x4 (b1,b2,b3halt,b4dead), orderA, preB, postB, preC, postC, case_model_glue, case_multi_output, case_e2e_fold
observation_schema.normalization: varnode descriptors use Ghidra space names (register/const) on both sides; op pcs allocated in creation order 8 bytes apart; def token trichotomy def/input/free with 'free' = no def and not setInput (the newVarnode-created locked-output varnode)

comparand.snapshot_model: immutable partial GAP-A crate snapshot: git archive of commit 181aa4c8 carrying the ActionPrototypeTypes output-locked attach arm; no source overlays

locked_attach_geometry.detail: retA b1: nin=2, in_last=register:0x0:4, def=free (no def, not setInput), typelock=1, mt=int — cc:4644-4646: newVarnode at the locked output storage, size from the int type (4, not the 8-byte register), appended then updateType(type,true,true)

append_at_last_slot.detail: retA b2: nin=3, in1=register:0x40:4 def=input untouched, in_last=register:0x0:4 — cc:4645 opInsertInput(op,vn,op->numInput()) appends as the LAST slot; a pre-existing value input is never replaced

halt_skip.detail: retA b3halt: nin=1, in_last=const:0x0:1 — cc:4643 getHaltType()!=0 continue (Rugra masks halt|badinstruction|unimplemented|noreturn|missing per op.hh:170-172)

dead_skip.detail: retA b4dead: nin=1, in_last=const:0x0:1 — cc:4642 isDead continue

iteration_order_and_identity.detail: orderA b1_lt_b2=1 (VarnodeBank create-index order = beginOp(CPUI_RETURN) address order), pair_distinct=1 (one fresh varnode per RETURN, never shared)

active_output_absent_when_locked.detail: orderA active=0 — the locked path never calls initActiveOutput; ActionReturnRecovery's output_type_locked early-exit stays the sole guard

void_gate.detail: preB/postB: locked=1 mt=void, nin=1, active=0 — cc:4639 TYPE_VOID gate skips the loop entirely and the else-arm is not taken

unlocked_control.detail: preC/postC: locked=0, nin=1 (no attach), active=1 — cc:4650-4651 unconditional initActiveOutput else-arm

apply_return_code.detail: rc=0 on all three scenarios both sides (Ghidra apply returns 0; Rugra returns NO_CHANGE=0)

pre_state_parity.detail: preA/preB/preC lock+metatype projections identical; C++ locked state built through the native setInternal+setPieces path, Rust through the flat FuncProto fields

model_glue.detail: Rugra derives the locked output storage from ProtoModel::default_x86_64().output_entries[0] instead of a FuncProto-owned output ProtoParameter (ANN-F glue, FSPEC-0001/FSPEC-0002); fixture pins only the observable address/space identity (RETURNFOLD-GAPA-PROTOTYPES-0001 residual)

multi_output.detail: model output list with >1 entry (multi-register return storage, PIECE joins) not projected; the default x86-64 model has exactly one output entry on both sides (RETURNFOLD-GAPA-PROTOTYPES-0001 residual)

e2e_fold.detail: end-to-end return-value fold (MarkExplicit numinstances / MarkImplied / PrintC implied inlining) needs GAP-D and print-stage fixtures; IR-level attach only here (RETURNFOLD-GAPA-UPSTREAM-0001 residual)
